evidenceCaveats: No capture file: the USB product ID (2972:0147) was measured on the Tiny A; devicePEQ constraints say 5 bands, hardware reads 10

tested.firmware: bcdDevice 1.10 (FiiO Control reads V1.2.0; the current firmware is not confirmed)

rangesAccepted.note: Ten bands on every slot (a count of 5 or 2 reads back as 10 with the old bands still active), USER1-3 and all seven filter types written and read back; preamp -12, 0 and +12 dB hold, whole dB only (-11.9 dB reads back -11.0).

acoustic.note: PK within 0.008 dB with the register as Q; LS 100 Hz and HS 8000 Hz within 0.025 dB with shelf Q = register / sqrt2 (7 of 7 cases fit). BP, LP, HP and AP (a pass filter is kept at 0 dB) and the preamp level were not measured.

persistence.note: Only a slot switch and back and two cold plugs were checked; a power cycle after a save was not tested.

settings.note: Volume, volume steps, balance, mic and light written, read back and restored on a Pixel; the USB audio row is never written. FiiO Control has no filter, DRE or gain item for the Tiny A.

tested.beyondVendor: The FiiO web app wrote PK, LS, HS, BP, LP, HP and AP on the Tiny A and every write echoed; Contour offers all seven (devicePEQ lists five bands, the unit has ten). Names of up to 8 characters (A-Z, 0-9) work as in the web app.
